### Status discipline

- **RESEARCH:** credited source; no active assimilation work is claimed.
- **IN QUEUE:** related public feature epic is planned.
- **UNDER DISSECTION:** related public epic is building; does not prove this particular external mod was replaced.
- **FIELD TEST:** related public epic is in testing; gameplay parity is not yet proven.
- **HONORED:** reserved for future **separately evidenced, human-accepted, published full functional replacement**; not inferred from issue closure.

The public [live roadmap](ROADMAP.md) has the exact epic statuses. The [Hall of Heroes](HALL_OF_HEROES.md) explains the tribute and original creators' rights. Icons on the unified hero are **original ARS schematic pictograms**; third-party mod icons will only be used where redistribution rights have been confirmed.
